source:
@@U01870@@
Darting polyp fibres, linked
To enmesh and overbear us!
And see! see mice of every hue,
How they crowd, and how they speed
Through the moss and through the heather!
Up and down the fireflies, too,
Flit and flicker, thronged together,
To bewilder and mislead!

@@U01872@@
(Sings.)

@@U01873@@
But tell me, are we standing? Say,
Which is moving, we or they?
All about us seems to spin,
Rocks and trees grimace and grin,
And, swollen and puffed, on either side,
Will-o’-the-wisps are multiplied.

@@U01875@@
Grab my coattail and hang tight!
This middle summit gives us a grand view
of Mammon, Lord of Wealth,
glowing in the mountain.

@@U01877@@
How strange!
Down there, far down,
a dull reddish glow,
like dawn’s first light,
feeling its way into the deepest chasms of the abyss.
Fumes rise, vapors drift,
a cloud of mist takes sudden fire,
creeping along, a slender thread,
then gushes up like a fountain of fame and
streams its way to the valley in numberless veins,
only there, there at the narrow turn,
to unite again in a single flow.
And there, nearby, sparks, like golden sand,
are strewn about.
translation:
@@U01870@@
飞镖息肉纤维，相连
来纠缠我们、压制我们！
瞧！看到各种颜色的老鼠，
他们如何拥挤以及他们的速度如何
穿过苔藓，穿过石南花！
萤火虫也上上下下，
闪烁闪烁，拥挤在一起，
迷惑和误导！

@@U01872@@
（唱歌。）

@@U01873@@
但告诉我，我们站着了吗？说，
哪个在移动，我们还是他们？
我们周围的一切似乎都在旋转，
岩石和树木都咧着嘴笑，
而且，两侧肿胀、浮肿，
鬼火成倍增加。

@@U01875@@
抓住我的燕尾服并坚持住！
这座中峰给我们带来了壮丽的景色
财富之主玛门，
在山上闪闪发光。

@@U01877@@
多么奇怪啊！
在那儿，在很远的地方，
暗红色的光芒，
就像黎明的第一缕曙光，
摸索着进入深渊的最深处。
烟雾上升，蒸气飘移，
一团薄雾突然燃起火焰，
一条细细的丝线蠕动着，
然后像名誉的喷泉一样喷涌而出
无数的静脉流向山谷，
只有在那里，在狭窄的转弯处，
再次团结在一个单一的流程中。
在那里，附近，火花，像金色的沙子，
到处都是。
